#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -24.0000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(6.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -5.0000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float bright = 1; // @tune @config overall lantern intensity
  static float spread = 12; // @tune horizontal scatter of the flock and its glints
  static float rise = 0.55; // @tune @config ascent speed
  static float lanterns = 20; // @tune @config number of lanterns in the flock

  // Dusk gradient backdrop: warm afterglow at the horizon, ink at zenith.
  // Three stops down the palette: CORAL at a third strength, VIOLET at a
  // quarter, then the canvas ink itself.
  sky() {
    float low, mid;
    low = 0.36;
    mid = 0.24;
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
      glColor4f(1.0 * low, 0.35 * low, 0.2 * low, 1);
      glVertex3f(-160, 0, -55);
      glVertex3f(160, 0, -55);
      glColor4f(0.55 * mid, 0.3 * mid, 1.0 * mid, 1);
      glVertex3f(160, 9, -55);
      glVertex3f(-160, 9, -55);
      glColor4f(0.55 * mid, 0.3 * mid, 1.0 * mid, 1);
      glVertex3f(-160, 9, -55);
      glVertex3f(160, 9, -55);
      glColor4f(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
      glVertex3f(160, 60, -55);
      glVertex3f(-160, 60, -55);
    glEnd();
  }

  // Stars twinkle out of phase; they dissolve into the bright horizon.
  stars() {
    float sy, tw;
    glPointSize(5);
    glBegin(GL_POINTS);
      for(k, 0, 90) {
        sy = 3 + 40 * rand(42, k);
        tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(2.3 * t + 6.28 * rand(43, k));
        glColor4f(0.92, 0.95, 0.98, 0.75 * tw * smoothstep(3, 10, sy));
        glVertex3f(150 * rand2(41, k), sy, -54);
      }
    glEnd();
  }

  // Translucent water: near edge stays clear so reflections read through,
  // the far edge goes opaque and mirrors the sunset to hide the seam.
  water() {
    float far;
    far = 0.3;
    glBegin(GL_QUADS);
      glColor4f(1.0 * far, 0.35 * far, 0.2 * far, 0.95);
      glVertex3f(-160, 0, -55);
      glVertex3f(160, 0, -55);
      glColor4f(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 0.55);
      glVertex3f(160, 0, 14);
      glVertex3f(-160, 0, 14);
    glEnd();
  }

  // Sparse firelight glints: pow() gates the sine so each spark spends
  // most of its cycle dark, then flashes. The glint field tracks `spread`
  // a third wider than the flock, so the sparks always fringe the water
  // under the lanterns instead of clumping when the flock scatters.
  glints() {
    float gx, gz, gp, ga;
    glPointSize(6);
    glBegin(GL_POINTS);
      for(k, 0, lanterns*2) {
        gx = 1.33 * spread * rand2(51, k);
        gz = 0 - 3 - 26 * rand(52, k);
        gp = TAU * rand(53, k);
        ga = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(1.8 * t + gp), 6);
        glColor4f(1.0, 0.85, 0.15, 0.85 * ga);
        glVertex3f(gx + 0.3 * sin(0.9 * t + gp), 0.04, gz);
      }
    glEnd();
  }

  // One lantern: two triangle fans make the paper bipyramid - dim CORAL
  // crown, AMBER flame-lit base - plus a flame point and a soft halo. All
  // five tints are one anchor scaled by `glow`, so a lantern fades as a
  // unit instead of drifting off-hue.
  lantern(px, py, pz, s, glow) {
    float ax;
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(px, py, pz);
      glScalef(s, s, s);
      glRotatef(14 * sin(0.8 * t + px + pz), 1, 0, 0.3);
      glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_FAN);
        glColor4f(0.5 * glow, 0.175 * glow, 0.1 * glow, 0.9);
        glVertex3f(0, 1.35, 0);
        glColor4f(glow, 0.35 * glow, 0.2 * glow, 0.9);
        for(k, 0, 7) {
          ax = TAU * k / 6;
          glVertex3f(0.6 * cos(ax), 0.42, 0.6 * sin(ax));
        }
      glEnd();
      glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_FAN);
        glColor4f(glow, 0.85 * glow, 0.15 * glow, 0.95);
        glVertex3f(0, 0, 0);
        glColor4f(glow, 0.35 * glow, 0.2 * glow, 0.9);
        for(k, 0, 7) {
          ax = TAU * k / 6;
          glVertex3f(0.6 * cos(ax), 0.42, 0.6 * sin(ax));
        }
      glEnd();
      glPointSize(7);
      glBegin(GL_POINTS);
        glColor4f(glow, 0.85 * glow, 0.15 * glow, 0.9);
        glVertex3f(0, 0.12, 0);
      glEnd();
      glPointSize(26);
      glBegin(GL_POINTS);
        glColor4f(0.9 * glow, 0.315 * glow, 0.18 * glow, 0.22);
        glVertex3f(0, 0.5, 0);
      glEnd();
    glPopMatrix();
  }

  // Per-lantern flight: seeded phase/speed/size, a 15-unit rise that
  // wraps, and a cycle counter that reshuffles x/z each lap (the wrap
  // lands while fade = 0, so respawns are invisible). mirror > 0.5 draws
  // the reflection copy instead, dimmed and wobbled by the water.
  launch(i, mirror) {
    float ph, spd, riseT, ypos, cyc, xpos, zpos;
    float fade, flick, dim, sz, g;
    ph = TAU * rand(11, i);
    spd = rise * (0.7 + 0.6 * rand(12, i));
    riseT = spd * t + 15 * rand(13, i);
    ypos = fmod(riseT, 15);
    cyc = floor(riseT / 15);
    xpos = spread * rand2(21, i + 9 * cyc) + 0.9 * sin(0.31 * t + ph);
    zpos = 0 - 5 - 20 * rand(22, i + 9 * cyc) + 0.7 * cos(0.23 * t + ph);
    fade = smoothstep(0, 2.5, ypos) * (1 - smoothstep(11, 15, ypos));
    flick = 0.82 + 0.18 * sin(5 * t + 6 * ph);
    dim = 1 - 0.6 * smoothstep(6, 26, 0 - zpos);
    sz = 0.5 + 0.35 * rand(23, i);
    g = bright * fade * flick * dim;
    if(mirror > 0.5) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glScalef(1, -1, 1);
        lantern(xpos + 0.18 * sin(1.6 * t + 0.7 * zpos), ypos + 0.35, zpos, sz, 0.5 * g);
      glPopMatrix();
    } else {
      lantern(xpos, ypos + 0.35, zpos, sz, g);
    }
  }

  // Keep config sensible
  rise = clamp(rise, 0.1, 2.0);
  bright = clamp(bright, 0.1, 10.0);
  lanterns = max(0, round(lanterns));

  // Lantern Festival - first night.
  // Paper lanterns rise off dark water into a dusk sky: additive glow,
  // wobbling reflections under a translucent water plane, twinkling
  // stars, and firelight glints riding the ripples. Every lantern is
  // deterministic - rand(seed, i) - so the flock repeats exactly, and a
  // wrapped lantern respawns at a reshuffled spot while faded to zero.

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_BLEND);
  glEnable(GL_POINT_SMOOTH);
  glPointParameterfv(GL_POINT_DISTANCE_ATTENUATION, (GLfloat[]){0.3, 0, 0.004});

  sky();
  stars();
  // Reflections go down first, under the water plane...
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  for(i, 0, lanterns) {
    launch(i, 1);
  }
  // ...then the translucent surface seals them in...
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
  water();
  // ...and the real flock burns additively above it.
  glDepthMask(GL_FALSE);
  glBlendFunc(GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL_ONE);
  glints();
  for(i, 0, lanterns) {
    launch(i, 0);
  }
  glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
